```plato

//==
// # Volumetric meshes
//
// Indexed volume elements over a shared vertex array: the tetrahedral and
// hexahedral cell records and the meshes built from them, as used by
// finite-element and structured simulation volumes.

// The four vertex indices of one tetrahedron
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tetrahedron), ordered so the signed volume is
// positive (D on the counter-clockwise side of triangle A-B-C).
type TetrahedronCell
    implements IValue, IHashable
{
    A: VertexIndex;
    B: VertexIndex;
    C: VertexIndex;
    D: VertexIndex;
}
```
